summary: Anfield Energy Inc. filed a 6-K disclosing the pricing of a US$6.0 million underwritten public offering of 1,491,305 common shares at US$4.00 per share, with an over-allotment option for 223,695 additional shares. The offering is led by Northland Capital Markets and Roth Capital Partners and is conducted under a base shelf prospectus in Canada and a Form F-10 registration statement in the U.S. Net proceeds fund capital commitments and working capital. Closing is expected on or about July 31, 2026, subject to TSXV approval. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
